fields.label: AGREEMENT_VALUE
fields.description: The monthly rent payable under the agreement. Digits only: no currency symbol, words, commas or decimals.

fields.label: AGREEMENT_START_DATE
fields.description: The date the rental/lease period begins, as DD.MM.YYYY. If the document says the period runs from the date of the agreement, use the date on which the agreement is made.

fields.label: AGREEMENT_END_DATE
fields.description: The date the rental/lease period ends, as DD.MM.YYYY. If the document gives the start date and a duration (for example eleven months) instead of an end date, return the last day of that period: the start date plus the duration, minus one day.

fields.label: RENEWAL_NOTICE_DAYS
fields.description: The advance notice period a party must give to terminate, vacate or not renew the agreement, as a number of days. Convert months to days using 1 month = 30 days. Digits only. Do not confuse it with the lease duration or rent payment dates.

fields.label: PARTY_ONE
fields.description: The owner/lessor/landlord who lets the property. If there are several, include all of them as written in the document.

fields.label: PARTY_TWO
fields.description: The tenant/lessee who takes the property on rent. If there are several, include all of them as written in the document.
